release_notes: Specs per the official QuarkView product page (Shenzhen Kuake Trading Co., Ltd.); the page states a 3MP label, a fixed 3.6 mm lens, 180-degree pan / 90-degree tilt, H.265, DC 12V external power, 2.4GHz-only Wi-Fi and microSD up to 128GB. No ONVIF or RTSP is stated and setup is via the EseeCloud app, so no configs are given. Night-vision illumination type, field of view, IP rating, sensor and dimensions are not published (the page only mentions an IR-cut day/night mode). Pan/tilt Wi-Fi camera typed ptz; no optical zoom is specified.
